title: Croatian Skewers with Fiordilatte
description: A keto twist on traditional Croatian skewers, featuring spicy and creamy elements.
instructions: 2. Cut the sausage into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, alternating with yellow bell peppers, onion, and garlic.
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
4. Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the sausage is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
5. Meanwhile, slice the Fiordilatte mozzarella into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
6. Once the skewers are cooked, serve with mozzarella on top and drizzle with your favorite sauce, if desired.
7. Enjoy as a keto-friendly lunch or dinner.
